entities.summary: Barry Ryan Enright is an American former professional baseball pitcher and pitching coach. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Arizona Diamondbacks and Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim. Enright attended St. Mary's High School in Stockton, California and Pepperdine University. He has also represented Great Britain internationally, including at the 2019 European Baseball Championship.
